A graduate of the American Academy of Dramatic Arts in Los Angeles, Kaime trained in the craft of acting with professional artists and master instructors. Following her move to Canada in 1980, she maintained a longstanding relationship with the Academy, serving for decades as a regional representative and adjudicator and conducting auditions for prospective students for its New York and Los Angeles campuses.
